issues.where: ring plane right of and below the globe (crops E, G, I, Q)
issues.what: the gap between globe and inner ring is filled with a separate patch of bright starfield with red nebula knots that does not match the sky around it; it reads as a cut-out with a different background pasted in
issues.fix: fill the inner ring gap with the same sky layer as the rest of the frame, or with dark unlit ring material, so no patch edge shows

issues.what: the day/night boundary is a straight diagonal soft band across the sphere, like a flat gradient overlay, instead of a curve that follows the globe; also true of image-05 crop A/P
issues.fix: shade the globe with a true spherical light term so the terminator curves with the limb

issues.where: lower right limb of globe (crops E, P, Q)
issues.what: the night-side limb bulges and the silhouette is uneven where it meets the shadowed ring, giving a lumpy, non-spherical edge
issues.fix: keep the globe silhouette an exact oblate ellipse and composite the ring over it cleanly

issues.where: right edge sky beside ring shadow (crops W, X)
issues.what: horizontal bluish streaks of light cross the sky with no source, like lens flare bands or a stray layer
issues.fix: remove the streaks or tie them to a visible light source

issues.where: outer edge of the outer ring, lower left (crops F, O, S of image-05 too)
issues.what: a thin bright blue-white rim line runs along the outer ring edge, reading as a halo or chromatic fringe
issues.fix: drop the rim highlight or match its colour to the ring material

issues.where: globe lower and mid bands (crops A, G, P)
issues.what: cloud bands are soft and airbrushed with little fine detail compared with the crisp storm filigree near the top; detail density is uneven
issues.fix: add fine band turbulence across the whole lit disc at consistent scale

issues.where: upper left Milky Way (crops H, J)
issues.what: the nebula is blotchy and painterly, with smeared orange clumps that look brushed rather than resolved
issues.fix: use a sharper star/dust layer with point-like stars and finer dust structure

issues.where: ring in shadow behind globe (crops E, R)
issues.what: the ring shadow has a hard straight edge while the shadowed ring texture fades to near-flat black, losing ring structure
issues.fix: keep faint ring structure visible inside the shadow and soften the penumbra slightly

issues.where: base of globe meeting inner rings (image-10.png crop A, image-11.png crops Q and R)
issues.what: the bottom of Saturn's globe curls inward with a shaded bevel like a solid puck resting on a glossy tabletop, casting a vertical mirror reflection onto the inner ring that terminates in a hard vertical patch seam against a bright ringlet
issues.fix: occlude the oblate globe cleanly behind the ring plane without a beveled lip, remove the specular tabletop reflection from the C-ring, and keep concentric ringlets continuous across the inner ring

issues.where: Milky Way sky above north limb and across background (image-15.png crops J, K, R and image-14.png crops B, E, G, H)
issues.what: faint curved stock-watermark-like ghost shapes appear in the dust lane just above the sunlit north limb in crop K, and Milky Way stars throughout the background are soft, irregular multi-pixel blobs with muddy grain
issues.fix: replace the background sky with a clean, watermark-free starfield rendered with sharp, consistent point-spread star profiles

issues.where: lower-left foreground outer A-ring (image-12.png crops T and U, image-10.png crop D)
issues.what: ringlets break down into coarse, jagged, bark-like stippled clumps and noisy chatter that clash with the smooth vector-like stripes of the adjacent B-ring in crops V and W
issues.fix: render the outer A-ring with clean radial optical-depth structure and fine, uniform azimuthal particle scattering matching the B-ring resolution

issues.where: lower sunlit globe above the ring intersection (image-11.png crop Q, image-10.png crop A)
issues.what: the cloud deck dissolves into flat, blocky, canvas-like rectangular painterly dabs with no zonal cloud banding
issues.fix: replace the patchy stippled surface on the lower globe with continuous sheared zonal bands and fine atmospheric texture consistent with the upper globe

issues.where: lower-left limb-ring crossing and bottom foreground rings (image-14.png crops D and I, image-16.png crops T, U, and V)
issues.what: the sunlit limb shifts color across a smeared semi-transparent seam behind the inner ring, stray bright star pixels sit directly on top of opaque foreground rings in crops D and I, and the bottom ring arc in crops T, U, and V is noticeably blurry compared to the upper-left rings
issues.fix: composite ring optical depth cleanly over the globe without ghosted seams, mask background stars behind opaque ring bands, and maintain uniform native sharpness around the full ring ellipse

issues.where: upper-left outer ring edge against the Milky Way (image-15.png crop J)
issues.what: a faint, broken, pixelated ghost line runs parallel roughly 12 pixels outside the main ring edge across the background stars
issues.fix: remove the stray doubled halo edge, or if depicting the F-ring, render it as a continuous, properly anti-aliased thin concentric ringlet

issues.where: small orange moon in upper center-right sky (image-15.png crop K)
issues.what: the moon exhibits visible stair-stepped pixels along its sunlit limb and a soft, featureless airbrushed interior at native crop scale
issues.fix: supersample the moon with clean sub-pixel limb anti-aliasing and a subtle, smooth atmospheric limb haze falloff

issues.where: north polar cap and upper-right nightside limb (image-14.png crop A, image-15.png crop K)
issues.what: the blue polar region is a smooth airbrushed gradient lacking fine polar vortex and concentric/hexagonal jet detail, and bright background star pixels clip unevenly along the dark limb silhouette
issues.fix: add subtle high-latitude concentric cloud bands and polar vortex detail, and anti-alias the dark planetary limb cleanly against the starfield
